name: Avell Control
author: milenagriz5
description: Power profile, temperatures and fans of the Avell A52 MOB in the bar, with a panel to switch the Power profile and toggle Max fan. A thin client of avellctl.

barWidget.description: Active Power profile, hottest temperature and fan speed; click for the control panel.

schema.label: Show temperature and fan speed beside the icon
